# Templates

These are copy-and-fill templates to speed up consistent Apex and LWC code. Replace all tokens like `{{Name}}` before use.

## Apex templates
- `docs/templates/apex/ServiceInterface.cls`
- `docs/templates/apex/ServiceImpl.cls`
- `docs/templates/apex/Selector.cls`
- `docs/templates/apex/Domain.cls`
- `docs/templates/apex/Controller.cls`
- `docs/templates/apex/ServiceTest.cls`

## LWC templates
- `docs/templates/lwc/component/component.js`
- `docs/templates/lwc/component/component.html`
- `docs/templates/lwc/component/component.css`
- `docs/templates/lwc/component/component.js-meta.xml`

## Notes
- Service and selector templates match the patterns used in `weather-app`.
- Test template uses `fflib_ApexMocks` from `apex-mocks`.
